query:
SELECT 
  hs.rfq_id,
  hs.status,
  hs.lock_tx_id,
  hs.reveal_tx_id,
  hs.from_chain,
  hs.to_chain,
  hs.from_amount,
  hs.to_amount,
  hs.created_at,
  hs.updated_at
FROM htlc_secrets hs
ORDER BY hs.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
